prompt: a printed one-piece thumb screw: a round head 20mm across and 8mm tall, and an M8 x 1.25 threaded shank with 30mm of thread below it
why: The only rung with a modelled thread, which is where G0's optional-feature rule bites (a helix swept inside try/except that silently drops the thread) and where the helix assertion is the only thing that fails a plain cylinder. One piece on purpose: a bare stud is registry hardware and never reaches a generator. assertionKinds requires the architect to have declared the helix and the kernel to have measured it.
